1A.title: Introduction to Philosophy & The Human Person

questions.text: What is the meaning of the word Philosophy?
Who is known as the Father of Western Philosophy?
Which branch of philosophy studies knowledge, truth, and how we know things?
What is the difference between knowledge and wisdom?

choices.A: Knowledge is knowing facts, while wisdom is applying facts correctly.
choices.B: Knowledge and wisdom have the same meaning.
choices.C: Knowledge comes from experience, while wisdom comes from books.
choices.D: Knowledge is about feelings, while wisdom is about beauty.

questions.text: Which branch of philosophy studies right and wrong behavior?
What are the five characteristics of a human being mentioned in the lesson?

choices.A: Physical, mental, moral, spiritual, and emotional

questions.text: In philosophy, what makes a person different from other beings?
What is self-awareness?

choices.A: Knowing the feelings of other people

questions.text: What is the difference between partial and holistic perspectives?

choices.A: Partial studies the whole, while holistic studies one part.
choices.B: Both perspectives have the same meaning.
choices.C: Partial focuses on one part, while holistic looks at the whole.
